title: isolepis exserens
intro: Isolepis exserens, commonly known as the Spike-rush, is a type of aquatic plant native to Australia and New Zealand. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in treating various skin conditions and wounds. Isolepis exserens is said to exhibit therapeutic actions including wound healing, anti-infective, and anti-pruritic properties. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
